title: Polite Requests and Promises at Work
titlePersian: درخواست و قول مؤدبانه در محیط کار
context: At work, direct requests can sound rude. You soften them with 'Would you mind…?' and 'Could you…?', you give honest but polite answers about deadlines, and you promise to get back to people.
contextPersian: در محیط کار درخواست‌های مستقیم ممکن است بی‌ادبانه به نظر برسند. آن‌ها را با «Would you mind…?» و «Could you…?» نرم می‌کنی، دربارهٔ موعدها پاسخ صادقانه اما مؤدبانه می‌دهی و قول پیگیری می‌دهی.

expressions.english: Would you mind sending me the file?
expressions.persian: ممکن است فایل را برایم بفرستید؟
expressions.example: Would you mind sending me the file before lunch?
expressions.examplePersian: ممکن است قبل از ناهار فایل را برایم بفرستید؟
expressions.note: Would you mind + -ing. A "no" answer means "no problem": No, not at all.

expressions.english: Would you mind if I opened the window?
expressions.persian: اگر پنجره را باز کنم ایرادی ندارد؟
expressions.example: Would you mind if I opened the window? It's quite hot.
expressions.examplePersian: اگر پنجره را باز کنم ایرادی ندارد؟ هوا خیلی گرم است.
expressions.note: After Would you mind if I + past simple.

expressions.english: Could you give me a hand with...?
expressions.example: Could you give me a hand with this report?
expressions.examplePersian: می‌شود در این گزارش کمکم کنید؟
expressions.note: A hand = help. Friendly and informal.

expressions.english: I'm not sure whether I can finish it by Monday.
expressions.persian: مطمئن نیستم بتوانم تا دوشنبه تمامش کنم.
expressions.example: I'm not sure whether I can finish it by Monday. There's a lot to do.
expressions.examplePersian: مطمئن نیستم بتوانم تا دوشنبه تمامش کنم. کار زیاد است.

expressions.english: I'm afraid I won't be able to...
expressions.example: I'm afraid I won't be able to join the call at three.
expressions.examplePersian: متأسفانه نمی‌توانم ساعت سه در تماس شرکت کنم.

expressions.english: Let me check and get back to you.
expressions.persian: اجازه بدهید بررسی کنم و خبرتان کنم.
expressions.example: I don't know yet. Let me check and get back to you.
expressions.examplePersian: هنوز نمی‌دانم. اجازه بدهید بررسی کنم و خبرتان کنم.

expressions.english: I'll get back to you by Friday.
expressions.example: I'll get back to you by Friday with a decision.
expressions.examplePersian: تا جمعه با یک تصمیم جوابتان را می‌دهم.
expressions.note: by Friday = not later than Friday.

expressions.english: Could we move the meeting to...?
expressions.persian: می‌شود جلسه را به ... منتقل کنیم؟
expressions.example: Could we move the meeting to Thursday?
expressions.examplePersian: می‌شود جلسه را به پنجشنبه منتقل کنیم؟

expressions.example: The deadline has changed? Thanks for letting me know.
expressions.examplePersian: موعد عوض شده؟ ممنون که خبر دادید.

expressions.example: Just to confirm, the deadline is Friday at noon, right?
expressions.examplePersian: فقط برای تأیید، موعد جمعه ظهر است، درست است؟

expressions.example: I'll send you a reminder on Thursday.

expressions.english: I'm tied up at the moment.
expressions.example: I'm tied up at the moment. Can I call you back in an hour?
expressions.examplePersian: الان سرم شلوغ است. می‌توانم یک ساعت دیگر تماس بگیرم؟

roleplay.aiRole: A busy colleague at the next desk
roleplay.objective: Make a request, give an honest answer about a deadline and promise to follow up
roleplay.context: You need a colleague to send you a file and you also have a task that may not be ready on time. Ask politely, say what you are not sure about, and promise to follow up with a date.
roleplay.opening: Hi, you wanted to talk to me? I'm a bit busy, but go ahead.
